concepts.question: How large is the single bright object at the centre of the image compared with the width of the whole image?

small.text: occupies less than about a third of the frame width, with wide dark margins on every side

medium.text: spans roughly half the frame width, the crop being about two nucleus-widths across

large.text: spans more than about two thirds of the frame width and nearly reaches opposite edges

concepts.question: Is the central bright object about as wide as it is tall, moderately longer in one direction, or clearly long and narrow?

round.text: about as wide as it is tall; no direction is clearly the longer one

oval.text: clearly longer one way than the other, but still blunt and rounded at both ends

elongated.text: a narrow strip whose long axis runs far across the frame while staying thin along its whole length

concepts.question: Is the outline of the central bright object smooth and unbroken, or is it notched, indented, or split into separate lobes?

smooth.text: the bright edge runs unbroken all the way round, with no notch cutting into it

indented.text: one or two dark notches bite into the edge without dividing the object in two

lobed.text: two or more bright blobs joined by thin bridges; a neutrophil nucleus carries three to five such lobes

concepts.question: Inside the central bright object, is the signal even across it, or is it broken up into brighter and darker patches?

uniform.text: brightness is even across the object; no patch stands out against its surroundings

mottled.text: faint lighter and darker patches show, but they blend into each other without sharp edges

coarsely_clumped.text: a few distinctly bright blocks sit against clearly darker gaps, with abrupt borders between them

concepts.question: How bright is the central object compared with the darkest background in the image?

dim.text: grey rather than white, only modestly above the dark background even at its centre

moderate.text: solidly bright over most of its area, with only the middle approaching white

bright.text: close to white and near-saturated over most of its area, the strongest signal in the frame

concepts.question: Apart from the central object, how many other bright objects or parts of them are visible anywhere in the image, including at the edges?

none.text: the central object is the only bright thing; all four frame edges stay dark

one_or_two.text: one or two further bright areas appear, typically cut off by the frame edge

several.text: three or more separate bright areas, so several frame edges carry a partial nucleus

concepts.question: Do the other bright objects in the image look like near-copies of one another in size and shape, or a mixture of clearly different sizes and shapes?

uniform.text: the other bright areas match one another closely in both size and shape

somewhat_mixed.text: the other bright areas differ noticeably in size or in shape, but not in both

markedly_mixed.text: the other bright areas differ in size and in shape at once: round, narrow and broad ones together

concepts.question: Compared with the other bright objects visible in the image, is the central one smaller, about the same size, or larger?

smaller.text: visibly narrower than the partial bright areas showing at the frame edge

similar.text: the same width as the partial nuclei at the frame edge, as far as one can tell

larger.text: clearly wider than any partial nucleus visible at the frame edge
